name: Project Management
description: Ability to scope, plan, schedule, and manage security engagements from kick-off through delivery. Covers effort estimation, resource planning, milestone tracking, client expectation management, and handling scope changes.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to project or engagement management

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the phases of a security engagement and basic project management concepts
evidence: Can describe the typical engagement lifecycle (scoping, execution, reporting, delivery)
Understands time tracking and task allocation

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Manages own workload within an engagement; provides status updates
evidence: Tracks own tasks and time accurately
Provides progress updates to engagement lead

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Leads small to medium engagements; manages timeline and deliverables
evidence: Led 3+ engagements from scoping to delivery
Demonstrates consistently reasonable effort estimates with post-engagement review
Manages client expectations on scope and timeline

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Manages complex, multi-team engagements; handles scope changes and escalations
evidence: Handles scope changes and client escalations professionally
Mentors junior staff on engagement management

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines engagement methodology; manages lab-wide resource planning
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's engagement management framework
Contributes to lab-wide capacity and resource planning
Trains teams on project management practices

assessment_methods.description: Review scoping documents, timelines, and status reports from recent engagements
Scenario: handle a mid-engagement scope change request with timeline and resource implications
